- Primary goal: keep inference unit economics to <= $15 / 1M tokens while preserving latency SLOs.
- Main asks from you: target $/1M tokens, whether you qualify for any startup program discounts, and how aggressive a committed-use discount we can provide for a 6-12 month commitment.

1) Expected monthly token volume (best guess range)
2) Target $/1M tokens that would work for your budget
3) Whether DeepFin is in any accelerator/startup program (and contact for legal if we need to route docs)

If you prefer, I can propose 2-3 committed tiers based on the volume you confirm and a recommended startup credit/discount. Aim: get to a mutually-signable proposal next week so your infra team can start integration.

Best,

Thanks Sam — this is helpful. Based on your ranges I put together two concrete options below (listed are effective $/1M token rates and the minimum monthly commit):

Option A — 6-month committed use
- Minimum commit: 50M tokens/month
- Effective rate: $14 / 1M tokens
- Startup credit: eligible startups get an extra 10% off for the first 3 months (subject to verification)
- Volume tiering: 0-50M @ $20/1M, 50-200M @ $14/1M, 200M+ @ $10/1M

Option B — 12-month committed use (recommended for better unit economics)
- Minimum commit: 75M tokens/month
- Effective rate: $11 / 1M tokens (after committed-use discount)
- Startup incentive: approved startups receive a one-time $10k credit + 12% off list for the first 6 months
- Volume tiering: 0-50M @ $18/1M, 50-200M @ $11/1M, 200M+ @ $8/1M

Notes:
- If you need to hit ~$10/1M target, we can bridge that with a combination of the 12-month commit + startup incentive; final pricing may require a commercial approval for multi-year escalation/credits.
- Attached is the startup program terms (startup_program_terms.pdf) and a redlined sample SOW in the proposal.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm which option (A or B) is closer to what you can commit to.
2) I'll loop in Aditya (sales leader) to sign off on any additional multi-year incentive or deeper discount.
3) Tara can indicate any contract constraints and required legal contacts.

Would you be free for a quick 20-minute call Monday to finalize?

Thanks — Marissa
Attachment: startup_program_terms.pdf

Proposal I'm asking you to approve:
- Offer a 12-month committed-use contract (Option B) with an effective rate of $11 / 1M tokens as outlined.
- Additionally approve a one-time startup incentive: $10k credit + 12% off for 6 months.
- As a stretch, approve a multi-year incentive to get to $10 / 1M effective (this would be a mix of additional credits or a 12% additional off-list for years 2-3).

If you can confirm the maximum allowable concession (either fixed $/1M floor or total $ credit) I can update the proposal and send to Tara for redlines.

Thanks — Marissa
